# id: PG-pg-86-balance-swimming
# covers: PG 194 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness 5AF3E517+ (44992a0: teleport moved=) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Avarek is teleported to deep water at Treefall (-61979 97 33880, findwater: depth 3.3, best run -x 500 m)
#   per point and swims 30 m along -x (swimtime). Result = swim_speed (deep distance / deep
#   seconds); runspeed adds the game's own swim_speed/max_swim_speed (harness 740ba0a+).
# verify: water_level=deep at every start; deep_fraction near 1; own50 > none = swimming reads the hooked stat.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
wake Avarek
speed 1
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek -61979 97 33880 ~ moved=1
speed 1
@sleep 8
speed 0
findwater Avarek radius 300 depth 1.5 ~ best_run=
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- w1: skill 10, gear none ---
setstat Avarek swimming 10
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
wake Avarek
speed 1
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek -61979 97 33880 ~ moved=1
speed 1
@sleep 3
water Avarek ~ water_level=deep
@set RS runspeed Avarek ~ (swim_speed=[\d.]+ max_swim_speed=[\d.]+)
@set T swimtime Avarek 30 -x ~ (deep_seconds=[\d.]+ deep_dist=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,194,swimming,10,0,none,w1,swim,0,${T},${RS}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w2: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek swimming 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
wake Avarek
speed 1
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek -61979 97 33880 ~ moved=1
speed 1
@sleep 3
water Avarek ~ water_level=deep
@set RS runspeed Avarek ~ (swim_speed=[\d.]+ max_swim_speed=[\d.]+)
@set T swimtime Avarek 30 -x ~ (deep_seconds=[\d.]+ deep_dist=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,194,swimming,90,0,none,w2,swim,0,${T},${RS}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
